source: Hugging Face Blog RSS and first-party article pages
ranking_method: recency + agent relevance + practical/research impact; human-readable evidence labels

items.title: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.

paper.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows

facts: ThinkingBox evaluates terminal backend state and side effects, rather than treating a plausible answer or valid tool call as task completion.
The blog reports 507 stateful business workflows and repeated trials, with a large gap between pass@1 and pass^20 reliability.
items.inference: 对需要可重复完成业务状态转移的智能体，单次成功率会高估部署可靠性。
items.recommendation: 将最终状态检查、重复试验和副作用审计纳入 agent 评测基线。
items.evidence_level: 一手来源；数字以论文摘要和原文为准

items.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents

paper.title: EnterpriseOps-Gym: Environments and Evaluations for Stateful Agentic Planning and Tool Use in Enterprise Settings

facts: AutoSynthData uses target-model failures and stronger-teacher successes to generate and validate a curriculum of enterprise tasks.
The linked EnterpriseOps-Gym paper describes 1,150 tasks, 512 tools and 164 database tables; its abstract reports only 37.4% success for the best evaluated model.
items.inference: 企业 agent 的训练数据需要围绕真实工具、持久状态和可执行验证器构造，而不是只扩充自然语言指令。
items.recommendation: 优先建立失败驱动的任务生成与样本级/批次级验证闭环。
items.evidence_level: 一手来源；实验数字来自 arXiv 摘要

items.title: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents

paper.title: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents

facts: ProvenanceGuard preserves MCP tool/source identity, checks claim support against the named source, and can block or repair answers.
The abstract reports block F1 0.802 and source accuracy 0.858 on a held-out split, while exact source-plus-relation accuracy remains difficult on close sources.
items.inference: MCP agent 的事实性应同时评价‘是否有证据’和‘是否归因于正确来源’。
items.recommendation: 在 trace 中保留稳定的 tool ID/source ID，并把 claim-to-source 映射作为独立评测维度。
items.evidence_level: 一手来源；指标来自 arXiv 摘要
